'''Fush Tournament HD''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 24 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Holotheatre|Dagobah-D-executorholotheatre.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Holotheatre
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Executor Holotheatre Fush DS 2003.txt |Download]]
